## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security/runtime cleanup
- [ ] Test/CI improvement
- [ ] Refactor with no behavior change
- [ ] Feature work

## Testing Performed

List commands run and their results.

## Screenshots

Include screenshots or short clips if UI changed.

## Security Considerations

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, `.env` files, local DBs, password hashes, or user records were committed.
- [ ] New configuration is documented.
- [ ] No new external service dependency is required for tests/CI.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept the change focused and reviewable.
- [ ] I updated documentation where needed.
- [ ] I added or updated tests where appropriate.
- [ ] Frontend lint/build/tests pass when frontend code changed.
- [ ] Backend dependency check/tests pass when backend code changed.
